_README: DIALOGUE TREE TEMPLATES — Copy any top-level key into starter_events.json or encounters.json and rename it. Delete this _README key, it is not a real event.

start.speaker: NPC Name
start.text: Opening line of dialogue. This is what the player sees first.

choices.label: Only option — moves to next node

node_2.speaker: NPC Name
node_2.text: Second beat. Single-choice nodes feel like a cutscene.

node_3.speaker: NPC Name
node_3.text: Final line. No choices = panel shows a 'Continue' button that closes the event.

start.speaker: Stranger
start.text: A mysterious figure approaches your ship on comms. "Captain, I have a proposition for you."

pitch.speaker: Stranger
pitch.text: "There's a cargo hold drifting nearby. I can't reach it alone. Split the loot 50-50?"

negotiate.speaker: Stranger
negotiate.text: "60-40, final offer. Take it or leave it."

accept_deal.speaker: Stranger
accept_deal.text: "Good choice, captain. Sending coordinates now. You won't regret this."

refuse.speaker: Stranger
refuse.text: "Your loss, captain." The signal cuts out.

attack.text: You open fire. The stranger's ship returns fire as it scrambles to escape.

start.speaker: Quartermaster
start.text: This template shows every effect type you can attach to nodes or choices.

resources.speaker: Quartermaster
resources.text: Resource effects — attach to 'effects' on nodes (fire on enter) or on choices (fire on pick).

flags.speaker: Quartermaster
flags.text: Tags and event chaining — set_tag saves state, queue_event schedules a follow-up event after a delay.

choices.label: Chain into another event (2-5 min delay)

start.speaker: Officer
start.text: Captain, we've intercepted a distress signal. Two ships are fighting nearby.

help_freighter.speaker: Freighter Captain
help_freighter.text: "Thank the stars! That raider's been chasing us for hours."

help_raider.speaker: Raider
help_raider.text: "Ha! Nice to have backup. Let's crack that hull open."

ignore.speaker: Officer
ignore.text: "Understood. Setting course away from the engagement."

aftermath.speaker: Officer
aftermath.text: All three branches land here. Use this pattern when paths diverge but the story continues from one point.

start.speaker: Comm Channel
start.text: This is a full encounter with all metadata fields filled in. Copy this into encounters.json and change the id to a unique number.

start.speaker: Scientist
start.text: Use queue_event to chain multi-part storylines. This event schedules Part 2 to fire 3-8 minutes later.

investigate.speaker: Scientist
investigate.text: "Fascinating readings. I'll need time to analyze this. I'll report back soon."

ignore.speaker: Scientist
ignore.text: "Your call, captain. But we may not get another chance like this."

start.speaker: Scientist
start.text: "Captain, my analysis is complete. The anomaly contains a rare mineral deposit."

mine.speaker: Scientist
mine.text: "Excellent yield, captain. This will keep us supplied for a while."

sell.speaker: Scientist
sell.text: "A practical choice. The credits will serve us well."
